findings.current: please stay and rest as long as you need
findings.defect: Adds an open-ended duration to the invitation. The Korean asks him to stay and rest well but does not specify that he may stay as long as necessary.
findings.rationale: 머무르십시오 invites him to stay, and 푹 쉬시며 asks him to rest well; neither phrase establishes a duration.
findings.replacement: please stay here and get plenty of rest

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with one minor added implication about how long the invitation to stay lasts.
